# 🔐 SecureChain — Software Supply Chain Security Platform

A comprehensive platform for managing software dependencies, build artifacts, and supply chain security threats.

## Features

- **Project Registry** — Register and manage software projects with metadata
- **Dependency Tracking** — Record and version-manage dependency trees
- **Vulnerability Scanning** — Identify CVEs, malicious packages, and risky versions
- **Risk Reports** — Generate detailed SBOM-style risk reports per project
- **Remediation Tracking** — Track fixes, patches, and security remediations
- **Threat Detection** — Detect dependency confusion, artifact tampering, secret leakage, and build compromise
- **Artifact Repository** — Store and verify build artifacts with checksums
- **Supply Chain Workflow** — Model developer → repo → build → deps → scan → artifact pipeline

## Architecture

```
securechain/
├── backend/           # FastAPI + SQLite backend
│   ├── app/
│   │   ├── api/       # REST endpoints
│   │   ├── core/      # Security scanner & threat engine
│   │   ├── db/        # Database models & migrations
│   │   └── schemas/   # Pydantic validation schemas
│   ├── main.py
│   └── requirements.txt
├── frontend/          # React + Vite frontend
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── pages/     # Dashboard, Projects, Dependencies, Reports
│   │   ├── components/# UI components
│   │   └── api/       # API client
│   └── package.json
└── docker-compose.yml
```

## Quick Start

### Backend
```bash
cd backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py
```

### Frontend
```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```

### Docker
```bash
docker-compose up --build
```

## Security Threats Addressed

| Threat | Detection Method |
|---|---|
| Dependency Confusion | Namespace & registry origin validation |
| Malicious Packages | Hash verification & known-bad registry |
| Artifact Tampering | SHA-256 checksum on all artifacts |
| Build Compromise | Build metadata & provenance tracking |
| Secret Leakage | Pattern scanning in dependency metadata |
| Supply Chain Attacks | Transitive dependency graph analysis |

## API Docs

Available at `http://localhost:8000/docs` (Swagger UI) after starting the backend.

"""
SecureChain — Software Supply Chain Security Platform
Database Models
"""
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum as PyEnum
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy import (
    Boolean, Column, DateTime, Enum, Float, ForeignKey,
    Integer, String, Text, JSON, func
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, relationship


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Enumerations
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────

class SeverityLevel(str, PyEnum):
    CRITICAL = "critical"
    HIGH = "high"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    LOW = "low"
    NONE = "none"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"

class ScanStatus(str, PyEnum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    RUNNING = "running"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"

class RemediationStatus(str, PyEnum):
    OPEN = "open"
    IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    RESOLVED = "resolved"
    WONT_FIX = "wont_fix"
    FALSE_POSITIVE = "false_positive"

class ThreatType(str, PyEnum):
    DEPENDENCY_CONFUSION = "dependency_confusion"
    MALICIOUS_PACKAGE = "malicious_package"
    ARTIFACT_TAMPERING = "artifact_tampering"
    BUILD_COMPROMISE = "build_compromise"
    SECRET_LEAKAGE = "secret_leakage"
    SUPPLY_CHAIN_ATTACK = "supply_chain_attack"
    CVE = "cve"
    OUTDATED = "outdated"
    LICENSE_VIOLATION = "license_violation"

class EcosystemType(str, PyEnum):
    NPM = "npm"
    PYPI = "pypi"
    MAVEN = "maven"
    NUGET = "nuget"
    RUBYGEMS = "rubygems"
    GO = "go"
    CARGO = "cargo"
    DOCKER = "docker"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"

class BuildStatus(str, PyEnum):
    SUCCESS = "success"
    FAILURE = "failure"
    RUNNING = "running"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Core Models
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────

class Project(Base):
    __tablename__ = "projects"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    description = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    repo_url = Column(String(512), nullable=True)
    default_branch = Column(String(128), default="main")
    ecosystem = Column(Enum(EcosystemType), default=EcosystemType.UNKNOWN)
    owner = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    team = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    metadata_ = Column("metadata", JSON, nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)

    # Relationships
    dependencies = relationship("Dependency", back_populates="project", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    builds = relationship("Build", back_populates="project", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    scans = relationship("SecurityScan", back_populates="project", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    artifacts = relationship("Artifact", back_populates="project", cascade="all, delete-orphan")


class Dependency(Base):
    __tablename__ = "dependencies"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    project_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("projects.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False)
    name = Column(String(512), nullable=False, index=True)
    version = Column(String(128), nullable=False)
    ecosystem = Column(Enum(EcosystemType), nullable=False)
    is_direct = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    is_dev = Column(Boolean, default=False)
    registry_url = Column(String(512), nullable=True)
    package_hash = Column(String(128), nullable=True)   # SHA-256 of downloaded package
    license = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    parent_dep_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("dependencies.id"), nullable=True)
    depth = Column(Integer, default=0)                  # 0 = direct dependency
    is_internal = Column(Boolean, default=False)        # internal / private package
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)

    project = relationship("Project", back_populates="dependencies")
    children = relationship("Dependency", backref="parent", remote_side="Dependency.id")
    findings = relationship("VulnerabilityFinding", back_populates="dependency", cascade="all, delete-orphan")


class Build(Base):
    __tablename__ = "builds"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    project_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("projects.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False)
    build_number = Column(String(128), nullable=False)
    commit_sha = Column(String(64), nullable=True)
    branch = Column(String(128), nullable=True)
    status = Column(Enum(BuildStatus), default=BuildStatus.RUNNING)
    builder = Column(String(255), nullable=True)         # CI system name
    build_tool = Column(String(255), nullable=True)      # Maven, Gradle, npm, etc.
    provenance = Column(JSON, nullable=True)             # SLSA provenance data
    secrets_detected = Column(Boolean, default=False)
    tampered = Column(Boolean, default=False)
    build_log_snippet = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    started_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    finished_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=True)

    project = relationship("Project", back_populates="builds")
    artifacts = relationship("Artifact", back_populates="build", cascade="all, delete-orphan")


class Artifact(Base):
    __tablename__ = "artifacts"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    project_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("projects.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False)
    build_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("builds.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True)
    name = Column(String(512), nullable=False)
    version = Column(String(128), nullable=True)
    artifact_type = Column(String(64), nullable=True)   # jar, whl, docker, zip, etc.
    sha256 = Column(String(128), nullable=True)
    size_bytes = Column(Integer, nullable=True)
    registry_path = Column(String(1024), nullable=True)
    is_signed = Column(Boolean, default=False)
    signature_key_id = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    tampered = Column(Boolean, default=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)

    project = relationship("Project", back_populates="artifacts")
    build = relationship("Build", back_populates="artifacts")


class SecurityScan(Base):
    __tablename__ = "security_scans"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    project_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("projects.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False)
    scan_type = Column(String(64), default="full")       # full | deps_only | secrets | sca
    status = Column(Enum(ScanStatus), default=ScanStatus.PENDING)
    triggered_by = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    total_deps_scanned = Column(Integer, default=0)
    critical_count = Column(Integer, default=0)
    high_count = Column(Integer, default=0)
    medium_count = Column(Integer, default=0)
    low_count = Column(Integer, default=0)
    risk_score = Column(Float, default=0.0)              # 0-100
    sbom = Column(JSON, nullable=True)                   # Software Bill of Materials
    started_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    completed_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=True)

    project = relationship("Project", back_populates="scans")
    findings = relationship("VulnerabilityFinding", back_populates="scan", cascade="all, delete-orphan")


class VulnerabilityFinding(Base):
    __tablename__ = "vulnerability_findings"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    scan_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("security_scans.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False)
    dependency_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("dependencies.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=True)
    threat_type = Column(Enum(ThreatType), nullable=False)
    severity = Column(Enum(SeverityLevel), nullable=False)
    cve_id = Column(String(64), nullable=True)
    title = Column(String(512), nullable=False)
    description = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    affected_package = Column(String(512), nullable=False)
    affected_version = Column(String(128), nullable=True)
    fixed_in_version = Column(String(128), nullable=True)
    cvss_score = Column(Float, nullable=True)
    attack_vector = Column(String(64), nullable=True)
    references = Column(JSON, nullable=True)
    evidence = Column(JSON, nullable=True)               # machine-readable proof
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)

    scan = relationship("SecurityScan", back_populates="findings")
    dependency = relationship("Dependency", back_populates="findings")
    remediations = relationship("Remediation", back_populates="finding", cascade="all, delete-orphan")


class Remediation(Base):
    __tablename__ = "remediations"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    finding_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("vulnerability_findings.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False)
    status = Column(Enum(RemediationStatus), default=RemediationStatus.OPEN)
    assigned_to = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    priority = Column(Integer, default=0)               # 1 (highest) – 5 (lowest)
    action = Column(String(512), nullable=True)
    notes = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    target_version = Column(String(128), nullable=True) # Upgrade-to version
    due_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=True)
    resolved_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)

    finding = relationship("VulnerabilityFinding", back_populates="remediations")


class ThreatIntelFeed(Base):
    """Known-bad packages / CVE reference table."""
    __tablename__ = "threat_intel_feeds"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    package_name = Column(String(512), nullable=False, index=True)
    ecosystem = Column(Enum(EcosystemType), nullable=False)
    threat_type = Column(Enum(ThreatType), nullable=False)
    severity = Column(Enum(SeverityLevel), nullable=False)
    cve_id = Column(String(64), nullable=True)
    affected_versions = Column(JSON, nullable=True)      # list of version ranges
    description = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    source = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)

    echo=False,
)

def init_db():
    """Create all tables."""
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)


def get_db():
    """FastAPI dependency that yields a DB session."""
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Scanner
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────

class SecurityScanner:
    """Run a comprehensive supply-chain security scan for a project."""

    def __init__(self, db: Session):
        self.db = db

    # ── public entry point ──────────────────────

    def run_scan(self, scan: SecurityScan) -> SecurityScan:
        """Execute all scan checks and persist results."""
        scan.status = ScanStatus.RUNNING
        self.db.commit()

        try:
            findings: List[VulnerabilityFinding] = []

            deps = self.db.query(Dependency).filter(
                Dependency.project_id == scan.project_id
            ).all()

            # 1. Dependency-level checks
            for dep in deps:
                findings += self._check_dependency(scan, dep)

            # 2. Build-level checks
            builds = self.db.query(Build).filter(
                Build.project_id == scan.project_id
            ).order_by(Build.id.desc()).limit(5).all()
            for build in builds:
                findings += self._check_build(scan, build)

            # 3. Artifact integrity checks
            artifacts = self.db.query(Artifact).filter(
                Artifact.project_id == scan.project_id
            ).all()
            for artifact in artifacts:
                findings += self._check_artifact(scan, artifact)

            # 4. Transitive / supply-chain graph analysis
            findings += self._check_supply_chain_depth(scan, deps)

            # Persist findings
            self.db.add_all(findings)

            # Update scan summary
            scan.total_deps_scanned = len(deps)
            scan.critical_count = sum(1 for f in findings if f.severity == SeverityLevel.CRITICAL)
            scan.high_count = sum(1 for f in findings if f.severity == SeverityLevel.HIGH)
            scan.medium_count = sum(1 for f in findings if f.severity == SeverityLevel.MEDIUM)
            scan.low_count = sum(1 for f in findings if f.severity == SeverityLevel.LOW)
            scan.risk_score = self._calculate_risk_score(findings, len(deps))
            scan.sbom = self._generate_sbom(scan.project_id, deps)
            scan.status = ScanStatus.COMPLETED
            scan.completed_at = datetime.utcnow()

        except Exception as exc:
            scan.status = ScanStatus.FAILED
            self.db.commit()
            raise exc

        self.db.commit()
        self.db.refresh(scan)
        return scan

    # ── dependency checks ────────────────────────

    def _check_dependency(
        self, scan: SecurityScan, dep: Dependency
    ) -> List[VulnerabilityFinding]:
        findings = []

        # (a) Known threat intel match
        findings += self._match_threat_intel(scan, dep)

        # (b) Dependency confusion detection
        cf = self._detect_dependency_confusion(scan, dep)
        if cf:
            findings.append(cf)

        # (c) Version anomaly / suspicious version string
        va = self._detect_version_anomaly(scan, dep)
        if va:
            findings.append(va)

        # (d) Missing hash / no integrity check
        hi = self._check_hash_integrity(scan, dep)
        if hi:
            findings.append(hi)

        return findings

    def _match_threat_intel(
        self, scan: SecurityScan, dep: Dependency
    ) -> List[VulnerabilityFinding]:
        findings = []
        records = self.db.query(ThreatIntelFeed).filter(
            ThreatIntelFeed.package_name.ilike(dep.name),
            ThreatIntelFeed.ecosystem == dep.ecosystem,
            ThreatIntelFeed.is_active == True,
        ).all()

        for record in records:
            if record.affected_versions and not self._version_in_range(
                dep.version, record.affected_versions
            ):
                continue

            findings.append(VulnerabilityFinding(
                scan_id=scan.id,
                dependency_id=dep.id,
                threat_type=record.threat_type,
                severity=record.severity,
                cve_id=record.cve_id,
                title=f"{record.threat_type.value.replace('_', ' ').title()}: {dep.name}@{dep.version}",
                description=record.description,
                affected_package=dep.name,
                affected_version=dep.version,
                cvss_score=self._severity_to_cvss(record.severity),
                attack_vector="network",
                references=[f"Source: {record.source}"] if record.source else None,
                evidence={"matched_intel_id": record.id, "dep_id": dep.id},
            ))
        return findings

    def _detect_dependency_confusion(
        self, scan: SecurityScan, dep: Dependency
    ) -> Optional[VulnerabilityFinding]:
        """Flag packages with internal-looking names published on public registries."""
        is_suspicious_name = any(
            re.match(p, dep.name, re.IGNORECASE)
            for p in INTERNAL_NAME_PATTERNS
        )

        # Also flag if marked as internal but has a public registry URL
        is_public_internal = (
            dep.is_internal
            and dep.registry_url
            and not any(x in (dep.registry_url or "") for x in [
                "localhost", "internal", "private", "artifactory",
                "nexus", "jfrog", "127.0.0.1",
            ])
        )

        if is_suspicious_name or is_public_internal:
            return VulnerabilityFinding(
                scan_id=scan.id,
                dependency_id=dep.id,
                threat_type=ThreatType.DEPENDENCY_CONFUSION,
                severity=SeverityLevel.HIGH,
                title=f"Dependency Confusion Risk: {dep.name}",
                description=(
                    f"Package '{dep.name}' has an internal-sounding name but may be "
                    "resolvable from a public registry. An attacker could publish a "
                    "malicious version at a higher version number to hijack builds."
                ),
                affected_package=dep.name,
                affected_version=dep.version,
                cvss_score=7.5,
                attack_vector="network",
                evidence={
                    "is_internal_name": is_suspicious_name,
                    "is_public_internal_pkg": is_public_internal,
                    "registry_url": dep.registry_url,
                },
            )
        return None

    def _detect_version_anomaly(
        self, scan: SecurityScan, dep: Dependency
    ) -> Optional[VulnerabilityFinding]:
        for pattern in SUSPICIOUS_VERSION_PATTERNS:
            if re.match(pattern, dep.version, re.IGNORECASE):
                return VulnerabilityFinding(
                    scan_id=scan.id,
                    dependency_id=dep.id,
                    threat_type=ThreatType.MALICIOUS_PACKAGE,
                    severity=SeverityLevel.HIGH,
                    title=f"Suspicious Version String: {dep.name}@{dep.version}",
                    description="The package version string contains suspicious keywords suggesting tampering.",
                    affected_package=dep.name,
                    affected_version=dep.version,
                    cvss_score=7.0,
                    evidence={"matched_pattern": pattern},
                )
        return None

    def _check_hash_integrity(
        self, scan: SecurityScan, dep: Dependency
    ) -> Optional[VulnerabilityFinding]:
        """Flag dependencies without a recorded package hash."""
        if not dep.package_hash:
            return VulnerabilityFinding(
                scan_id=scan.id,
                dependency_id=dep.id,
                threat_type=ThreatType.ARTIFACT_TAMPERING,
                severity=SeverityLevel.LOW,
                title=f"No Integrity Hash: {dep.name}@{dep.version}",
                description=(
                    "No SHA-256 hash is recorded for this dependency. "
                    "Without hash pinning, the package could be silently replaced."
                ),
                affected_package=dep.name,
                affected_version=dep.version,
                cvss_score=3.5,
                evidence={"dep_id": dep.id},
            )
        return None

    # ── build checks ─────────────────────────────

    def _check_build(
        self, scan: SecurityScan, build: Build
    ) -> List[VulnerabilityFinding]:
        findings = []

        # Secret leakage in build log
        if build.build_log_snippet:
            findings += self._scan_for_secrets(scan, build)

        # Missing provenance (SLSA)
        if not build.provenance:
            findings.append(VulnerabilityFinding(
                scan_id=scan.id,
                threat_type=ThreatType.BUILD_COMPROMISE,
                severity=SeverityLevel.MEDIUM,
                title=f"Missing Build Provenance: Build #{build.build_number}",
                description=(
                    "No SLSA provenance data found for this build. "
                    "Without provenance it's impossible to verify how an artifact was produced."
                ),
                affected_package=f"build:{build.build_number}",
                affected_version=build.commit_sha or "unknown",
                cvss_score=5.0,
                evidence={"build_id": build.id},
            ))

        # Tampered flag already set by earlier checks
        if build.tampered:
            findings.append(VulnerabilityFinding(
                scan_id=scan.id,
                threat_type=ThreatType.BUILD_COMPROMISE,
                severity=SeverityLevel.CRITICAL,
                title=f"Build Compromise Detected: Build #{build.build_number}",
                description="Build metadata indicates tampering was previously flagged.",
                affected_package=f"build:{build.build_number}",
                affected_version=build.commit_sha or "unknown",
                cvss_score=9.8,
                evidence={"build_id": build.id, "tampered": True},
            ))

        return findings

    def _scan_for_secrets(
        self, scan: SecurityScan, build: Build
    ) -> List[VulnerabilityFinding]:
        findings = []
        text = build.build_log_snippet or ""
        for pattern, label in SECRET_PATTERNS:
            if re.search(pattern, text):
                findings.append(VulnerabilityFinding(
                    scan_id=scan.id,
                    threat_type=ThreatType.SECRET_LEAKAGE,
                    severity=SeverityLevel.HIGH,
                    title=f"Secret Detected in Build Log: {label}",
                    description=(
                        f"A potential {label} was found in build #{build.build_number} logs. "
                        "Exposed secrets must be rotated immediately."
                    ),
                    affected_package=f"build:{build.build_number}",
                    affected_version=build.commit_sha or "unknown",
                    cvss_score=8.0,
                    attack_vector="local",
                    evidence={"build_id": build.id, "secret_type": label},
                ))
                # Mark build as secrets_detected
                build.secrets_detected = True
        return findings

    # ── artifact checks ──────────────────────────

    def _check_artifact(
        self, scan: SecurityScan, artifact: Artifact
    ) -> List[VulnerabilityFinding]:
        findings = []

        # No SHA-256 recorded
        if not artifact.sha256:
            findings.append(VulnerabilityFinding(
                scan_id=scan.id,
                threat_type=ThreatType.ARTIFACT_TAMPERING,
                severity=SeverityLevel.MEDIUM,
                title=f"Artifact Missing Checksum: {artifact.name}",
                description=(
                    f"Artifact '{artifact.name}' has no SHA-256 checksum. "
                    "Without a checksum, tampering cannot be detected."
                ),
                affected_package=artifact.name,
                affected_version=artifact.version or "unknown",
                cvss_score=5.5,
                evidence={"artifact_id": artifact.id},
            ))

        # Not signed
        if not artifact.is_signed:
            findings.append(VulnerabilityFinding(
                scan_id=scan.id,
                threat_type=ThreatType.ARTIFACT_TAMPERING,
                severity=SeverityLevel.LOW,
                title=f"Unsigned Artifact: {artifact.name}",
                description=(
                    f"Artifact '{artifact.name}' is not cryptographically signed. "
                    "Signing artifacts ensures authenticity and non-repudiation."
                ),
                affected_package=artifact.name,
                affected_version=artifact.version or "unknown",
                cvss_score=3.0,
                evidence={"artifact_id": artifact.id},
            ))

        if artifact.tampered:
            findings.append(VulnerabilityFinding(
                scan_id=scan.id,
                threat_type=ThreatType.ARTIFACT_TAMPERING,
                severity=SeverityLevel.CRITICAL,
                title=f"Artifact Tampered: {artifact.name}",
                description="Checksum mismatch or tampering flag was set for this artifact.",
                affected_package=artifact.name,
                affected_version=artifact.version or "unknown",
                cvss_score=9.5,
                evidence={"artifact_id": artifact.id},
            ))

        return findings

    # ── supply-chain graph check ─────────────────

    def _check_supply_chain_depth(
        self, scan: SecurityScan, deps: List[Dependency]
    ) -> List[VulnerabilityFinding]:
        findings = []
        deep = [d for d in deps if d.depth >= 5]
        if deep:
            findings.append(VulnerabilityFinding(
                scan_id=scan.id,
                threat_type=ThreatType.SUPPLY_CHAIN_ATTACK,
                severity=SeverityLevel.MEDIUM,
                title=f"Deep Transitive Dependency Chain ({len(deep)} packages at depth ≥5)",
                description=(
                    "Deeply nested transitive dependencies significantly increase supply-chain "
                    "attack surface. Each level adds a new trust boundary that could be compromised."
                ),
                affected_package="<transitive graph>",
                affected_version="multiple",
                cvss_score=5.0,
                evidence={"deep_dep_ids": [d.id for d in deep[:10]]},
            ))
        return findings

    # ── helpers ──────────────────────────────────

    def _version_in_range(self, version: str, ranges: List[str]) -> bool:
        """Simple substring/prefix version matching (production would use packaging.version)."""
        if not ranges:
            return True
        for r in ranges:
            if r.startswith("<"):
                # very simplified: just flag if the package is listed
                return True
            if version == r or version.startswith(r.rstrip(".*")):
                return True
        return True  # be conservative — flag if in doubt

    def _severity_to_cvss(self, severity: SeverityLevel) -> float:
        mapping = {
            SeverityLevel.CRITICAL: 9.8,
            SeverityLevel.HIGH: 7.5,
            SeverityLevel.MEDIUM: 5.0,
            SeverityLevel.LOW: 3.0,
            SeverityLevel.NONE: 0.0,
            SeverityLevel.UNKNOWN: 5.0,
        }
        return mapping.get(severity, 5.0)

    def _calculate_risk_score(
        self, findings: List[VulnerabilityFinding], total_deps: int
    ) -> float:
        """Weighted risk score 0-100."""
        if not findings and total_deps == 0:
            return 0.0
        weights = {
            SeverityLevel.CRITICAL: 40,
            SeverityLevel.HIGH: 20,
            SeverityLevel.MEDIUM: 8,
            SeverityLevel.LOW: 2,
        }
        raw = sum(weights.get(f.severity, 0) for f in findings)
        # Normalize: 100 = 3 criticals or equivalent
        score = min(100.0, (raw / 120.0) * 100)
        return round(score, 2)

    def _generate_sbom(
        self, project_id: int, deps: List[Dependency]
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Generate a simplified CycloneDX-style SBOM."""
        return {
            "bomFormat": "CycloneDX",
            "specVersion": "1.4",
            "version": 1,
            "metadata": {
                "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
                "component": {"type": "application", "bom-ref": f"project-{project_id}"},
            },
            "components": [
                {
                    "type": "library",
                    "bom-ref": f"dep-{d.id}",
                    "name": d.name,
                    "version": d.version,
                    "purl": f"pkg:{d.ecosystem.value}/{d.name}@{d.version}",
                    "hashes": [{"alg": "SHA-256", "content": d.package_hash}]
                    if d.package_hash else [],
                    "licenses": [{"license": {"name": d.license}}] if d.license else [],
                    "scope": "required" if not d.is_dev else "optional",
                }
                for d in deps
            ],
        }


def seed_threat_intel(db: Session) -> None:
    """Populate threat intel table with built-in seed data."""
    existing = db.query(ThreatIntelFeed).count()
    if existing > 0:
        return  # already seeded

    for entry in SEED_THREAT_INTEL:
        record = ThreatIntelFeed(**entry)
        db.add(record)
    db.commit()

"""
Projects API Router
"""
from typing import List, Optional
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from sqlalchemy import func

from app.db import get_db
from app.db.models import Dependency, Project, SecurityScan, VulnerabilityFinding, SeverityLevel
from app.schemas import ProjectCreate, ProjectOut, ProjectUpdate, ProjectSummary

router = APIRouter(prefix="/projects", tags=["Projects"])


@router.get("/", response_model=List[ProjectSummary])
def list_projects(
    skip: int = 0,
    limit: int = 50,
    ecosystem: Optional[str] = None,
    is_active: Optional[bool] = None,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    q = db.query(Project)
    if ecosystem:
        q = q.filter(Project.ecosystem == ecosystem)
    if is_active is not None:
        q = q.filter(Project.is_active == is_active)
    projects = q.offset(skip).limit(limit).all()

    results = []
    for p in projects:
        total_deps = db.query(Dependency).filter(Dependency.project_id == p.id).count()
        last_scan = (
            db.query(SecurityScan)
            .filter(SecurityScan.project_id == p.id)
            .order_by(SecurityScan.id.desc())
            .first()
        )
        critical = 0
        risk_score = 0.0
        last_scan_at = None
        if last_scan:
            critical = last_scan.critical_count
            risk_score = last_scan.risk_score
            last_scan_at = last_scan.completed_at

        results.append(ProjectSummary(
            **ProjectOut.model_validate(p).model_dump(),
            total_deps=total_deps,
            critical_findings=critical,
            last_scan_at=last_scan_at,
            risk_score=risk_score,
        ))
    return results


@router.post("/", response_model=ProjectOut, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_project(payload: ProjectCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    existing = db.query(Project).filter(Project.name == payload.name).first()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"Project '{payload.name}' already exists")

    data = payload.model_dump(by_alias=False)
    meta = data.pop("metadata_", None)
    project = Project(**data, metadata_=meta)
    db.add(project)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(project)
    return project


@router.get("/{project_id}", response_model=ProjectSummary)
def get_project(project_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    p = _get_or_404(project_id, db)
    total_deps = db.query(Dependency).filter(Dependency.project_id == p.id).count()
    last_scan = (
        db.query(SecurityScan)
        .filter(SecurityScan.project_id == p.id)
        .order_by(SecurityScan.id.desc())
        .first()
    )
    return ProjectSummary(
        **ProjectOut.model_validate(p).model_dump(),
        total_deps=total_deps,
        critical_findings=last_scan.critical_count if last_scan else 0,
        last_scan_at=last_scan.completed_at if last_scan else None,
        risk_score=last_scan.risk_score if last_scan else 0.0,
    )


@router.patch("/{project_id}", response_model=ProjectOut)
def update_project(project_id: int, payload: ProjectUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    p = _get_or_404(project_id, db)
    for field, value in payload.model_dump(exclude_none=True).items():
        setattr(p, field, value)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(p)
    return p


@router.delete("/{project_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def delete_project(project_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    p = _get_or_404(project_id, db)
    db.delete(p)
    db.commit()


def _get_or_404(project_id: int, db: Session) -> Project:
    p = db.query(Project).filter(Project.id == project_id).first()
    if not p:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Project {project_id} not found")
    return p

"""
Builds & Artifacts API Router
"""
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Optional
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db import get_db
from app.db.models import Artifact, Build, BuildStatus, Project
from app.schemas import ArtifactCreate, ArtifactOut, BuildCreate, BuildOut

router = APIRouter(tags=["Builds & Artifacts"])


# ── Builds ──────────────────────────────────────

@router.get("/projects/{project_id}/builds", response_model=List[BuildOut])
def list_builds(
    project_id: int,
    skip: int = 0,
    limit: int = 20,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    _get_project(project_id, db)
    return (
        db.query(Build)
        .filter(Build.project_id == project_id)
        .order_by(Build.id.desc())
        .offset(skip)
        .limit(limit)
        .all()
    )


@router.post(
    "/projects/{project_id}/builds",
    response_model=BuildOut,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def create_build(
    project_id: int, payload: BuildCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    _get_project(project_id, db)
    build = Build(project_id=project_id, **payload.model_dump())
    db.add(build)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(build)
    return build


@router.get("/projects/{project_id}/builds/{build_id}", response_model=BuildOut)
def get_build(project_id: int, build_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    return _get_build(project_id, build_id, db)


@router.patch("/projects/{project_id}/builds/{build_id}/complete", response_model=BuildOut)
def complete_build(
    project_id: int,
    build_id: int,
    build_status: BuildStatus = BuildStatus.SUCCESS,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    build = _get_build(project_id, build_id, db)
    build.status = build_status
    build.finished_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(build)
    return build


# ── Artifacts ───────────────────────────────────

@router.get("/projects/{project_id}/artifacts", response_model=List[ArtifactOut])
def list_artifacts(
    project_id: int,
    skip: int = 0,
    limit: int = 50,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    _get_project(project_id, db)
    return (
        db.query(Artifact)
        .filter(Artifact.project_id == project_id)
        .order_by(Artifact.id.desc())
        .offset(skip)
        .limit(limit)
        .all()
    )


@router.post(
    "/projects/{project_id}/artifacts",
    response_model=ArtifactOut,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def register_artifact(
    project_id: int, payload: ArtifactCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    _get_project(project_id, db)
    artifact = Artifact(project_id=project_id, **payload.model_dump())
    db.add(artifact)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(artifact)
    return artifact


@router.patch("/projects/{project_id}/artifacts/{artifact_id}/verify", response_model=ArtifactOut)
def verify_artifact(
    project_id: int,
    artifact_id: int,
    provided_hash: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Verify artifact integrity by comparing SHA-256 checksums."""
    artifact = db.query(Artifact).filter(
        Artifact.project_id == project_id,
        Artifact.id == artifact_id,
    ).first()
    if not artifact:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Artifact not found")

    if not artifact.sha256:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No reference checksum on record")

    if artifact.sha256.lower() != provided_hash.lower():
        artifact.tampered = True
        db.commit()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail=f"Checksum mismatch! Artifact may have been tampered with. "
                   f"Expected: {artifact.sha256} — Got: {provided_hash}",
        )

    db.refresh(artifact)
    return artifact


# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────

def _get_project(project_id: int, db: Session) -> Project:
    p = db.query(Project).filter(Project.id == project_id).first()
    if not p:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Project {project_id} not found")
    return p


def _get_build(project_id: int, build_id: int, db: Session) -> Build:
    b = db.query(Build).filter(
        Build.project_id == project_id, Build.id == build_id
    ).first()
    if not b:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Build {build_id} not found")
    return b

"""
Dashboard & Threat Intel API Router
"""
from typing import List
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db import get_db
from app.db.models import (
    Dependency, EcosystemType, Project, Remediation, RemediationStatus,
    SecurityScan, ScanStatus, ThreatIntelFeed, VulnerabilityFinding
)
from app.schemas import DashboardStats, ScanOut, ThreatIntelCreate, ThreatIntelOut

router = APIRouter(tags=["Dashboard & Threat Intel"])


@router.get("/dashboard", response_model=DashboardStats)
def get_dashboard(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    total_projects = db.query(Project).count()
    active_projects = db.query(Project).filter(Project.is_active == True).count()
    total_deps = db.query(Dependency).count()
    total_scans = db.query(SecurityScan).count()
    total_findings = db.query(VulnerabilityFinding).count()

    critical_findings = db.query(VulnerabilityFinding).filter(
        VulnerabilityFinding.severity == "critical"
    ).count()

    open_remediations = db.query(Remediation).filter(
        Remediation.status == RemediationStatus.OPEN
    ).count()
    resolved_remediations = db.query(Remediation).filter(
        Remediation.status == RemediationStatus.RESOLVED
    ).count()

    # Average risk score from latest scans per project
    avg_risk = db.query(func.avg(SecurityScan.risk_score)).scalar() or 0.0

    recent_scans = (
        db.query(SecurityScan)
        .order_by(SecurityScan.id.desc())
        .limit(5)
        .all()
    )

    # Severity distribution
    severity_rows = db.query(
        VulnerabilityFinding.severity, func.count()
    ).group_by(VulnerabilityFinding.severity).all()
    severity_dist = {row[0]: row[1] for row in severity_rows}

    # Threat type distribution
    threat_rows = db.query(
        VulnerabilityFinding.threat_type, func.count()
    ).group_by(VulnerabilityFinding.threat_type).all()
    threat_dist = {row[0]: row[1] for row in threat_rows}

    # Ecosystem distribution (from dependencies)
    eco_rows = db.query(
        Dependency.ecosystem, func.count()
    ).group_by(Dependency.ecosystem).all()
    eco_dist = {row[0]: row[1] for row in eco_rows}

    return DashboardStats(
        total_projects=total_projects,
        active_projects=active_projects,
        total_dependencies=total_deps,
        total_scans=total_scans,
        total_findings=total_findings,
        critical_findings=critical_findings,
        open_remediations=open_remediations,
        resolved_remediations=resolved_remediations,
        avg_risk_score=round(float(avg_risk), 2),
        recent_scans=[ScanOut.model_validate(s) for s in recent_scans],
        severity_distribution={str(k): v for k, v in severity_dist.items()},
        threat_type_distribution={str(k): v for k, v in threat_dist.items()},
        ecosystem_distribution={str(k): v for k, v in eco_dist.items()},
    )


# ── Threat Intel Feed ────────────────────────────

@router.get("/threat-intel", response_model=List[ThreatIntelOut])
def list_threat_intel(
    skip: int = 0,
    limit: int = 100,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    return db.query(ThreatIntelFeed).filter(
        ThreatIntelFeed.is_active == True
    ).offset(skip).limit(limit).all()


@router.post(
    "/threat-intel",
    response_model=ThreatIntelOut,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def add_threat_intel(payload: ThreatIntelCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    record = ThreatIntelFeed(**payload.model_dump())
    db.add(record)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    return record


@router.delete("/threat-intel/{intel_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def deactivate_threat_intel(intel_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    record = db.query(ThreatIntelFeed).filter(ThreatIntelFeed.id == intel_id).first()
    if not record:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Threat intel record not found")
    record.is_active = False
    db.commit()
